events.why: step 62: back onto the road at the catch spots (60, and 100 first when further), by the objective marker. metadata.source: console B recording, 2026-11-08/09: played step by step from a new game; split from 03.08 at the last catch's autosave, so a checkpoint starts where a save reloads.
